label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-controlled 'seg' parameter which is not validated. Although 'host' is checked against a strict regex, 'seg' accepts raw input (defaulting to "home"), allowing attackers to craft values like "/\/evil.com" to achieve an Open Redirect. The sink concatenates 'seg' directly into the redirect URL without sanitization.

evidence.note: User input 'seg' retrieved from request and concatenated into sendRedirect without validation
